offering_description.value: Operates cable television networks and subscription streaming services featuring scripted series, films and genre content. It also produces and licenses original programming to third-party distributors and platforms. Customers are pay-TV distributors, advertisers, streaming subscribers and content licensees.

primary_products.value: cable television channels; subscription streaming services; original series and films; licensed content

primary_services.value: television programming distribution; advertising sales; content production and licensing; film distribution

customer_segment.value: B2B: cable, satellite and virtual pay-TV distributors, advertisers, streaming platforms licensing content; B2C: streaming subscribers paying for genre-focused services

end_markets.value: television; streaming entertainment; advertising; film distribution

revenue_model.value: service fees: carriage fees paid by pay-TV distributors for networks; advertising: ad sales on cable networks and streaming services; subscription: direct-to-consumer streaming subscriptions; licensing or royalties: licensing of original content to other distributors and platforms
revenue_model.category: service fees; advertising; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns networks and streaming brands, programming sold to distributors, advertisers and viewers; service provider: produces and licenses original content to third-party platforms

geography_served.value: global: US primary market, plus streaming and networks in UK, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: cable networks, genre streaming services and content studio/licensing

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: cable, satellite and virtual pay-TV operators carrying networks, streaming bundles and app marketplaces; online: direct-to-consumer streaming apps and websites; direct sales: advertising sales to brands and agencies, content licensing deals

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: broadcast content, advertising and data privacy rules including FCC-related carriage rules and FTC
